def extract_discovered_claims(claims) when is_map(claims) do claims |> Nebu.Web.OidcClaims.flatten_discovered_claims(nil) |> Enum.uniq() end # HTML-escape a value (the token is attacker-influenceable — escape every interpolation). defp esc(s), do: s |> Phoenix.HTML.html_escape() |> Phoenix.HTML.safe_to_string() defp select_claim_html(claims) do options = claims |> extract_discovered_claims() |> Enum.with_index() |> Enum.map_join("\n", fn {{key, value}, idx} -> id = "claim-#{idx}" # scope-admin-claim-to-path (AC2): each radio submits BOTH the claim value # (existing "admin_group_claim" param, unchanged) and its dot-path key (new # "admin_group_claim_path" param) via a single JSON-encoded value, decoded by # the form-submit handler below into two POST params. Plain HTML has no way # to bind two independently-named radio groups to one click without JS, so # encoding both pieces of data into the ONE value the browser submits is the # standard no-JS-required technique. `key` is `nil` for a top-level bare claim # with no discoverable dot-path (extract_discovered_claims/1 never produces a # nil key today, but the encoding tolerates it defensively). encoded = Jason.encode!(%{"value" => value, "path" => key}) """
    • """ end) """ Select admin group claim · Nebu Admin

    Bootstrap Setup

    Select the claim value that identifies an instance administrator. These are the discovered OIDC claims from your account.

      #{options}
    """ end end
